FOUNDER PORTRAIT
REPLACE WITH PHOTOGRAPH

A WORD FROM OUR FOUNDER

Built with patience, backed by real assets.

I have always believed that the most valuable businesses are the ones built slowly and honestly — on real assets, sound judgement, and relationships that outlast any single transaction.

That conviction shapes everything we do. In property, we create and hold coastal assets designed to appreciate over decades, not quarters. In energy, we are taking a licensed and disciplined path into the sector that powers our region — intent on building the infrastructure the coast needs, and building it the right way.

What unites the two is a single standard: tangible value, careful execution, and a duty to the communities and the coastline we depend on. We measure success not by how quickly we grow, but by how well what we build endures.

The Kenyan coast is entering a defining decade. Its future belongs to those willing to invest with patience, integrity, and a long-term view — and that is precisely how we intend to build.

To our partners, clients, and investors: thank you for the confidence you place in us. We will honour it by protecting the name behind this company, and by always looking well beyond the next deal.

Haji Mukhtar

FOUNDER, HAJI MUKHTAR PROPERTIES & PETROLEUM

ENERGY DIVISION · THE OPPORTUNITY

A Licensed Energy Entry

We hold a Petroleum Business Licence for the export and wholesale of petroleum products (except LPG), issued under the Petroleum Act 2019 by Kenya's Energy & Petroleum Regulatory Authority — Licence No. EPRA/PET/12195. With this regulatory foundation in place, we are developing downstream infrastructure at Mombasa — East Africa's fuel gateway — working with strategic and joint-venture partners.

EPRA-licensed

Petroleum Business Licence EPRA/PET/12195 — export & wholesale (except LPG), under the Petroleum Act 2019.

Mombasa gateway

The port of entry for fuel serving Kenya and the landlocked interior.

Partnerships

We engage selectively with strategic, institutional and joint-venture partners on Phase 1 infrastructure.

BUILD-OUT ROADMAP

SECURED ✓

Licensing

PHASE 1 · NOW

PHASE 2

THE COMPANY

One company, two engines of value.

Haji Mukhtar Properties & Petroleum Ltd pairs a proven coastal real-estate track record with a licensed entry into downstream energy — the delivered business funding and de-risking the next.

The company is Kenyan-incorporated and Mombasa-based, led by its founder, Haji Mukhtar, and built for investors who want African growth secured against real, tangible assets.
